A025272.name: a(n) = a(1)*a(n-1) + a(2)*a(n-2) + ...+ a(n-1)*a(1) for n >= 5, with initial values 1,1,1,2.

A064090.author: _Wolfdieter Lang_, Sep 13 2001
gfs: (1+7*x*c(7*x)/6)/(1+x/6) = 1/(1-x*c(7*x)) with c(x) g.f. of Catalan numbers A000108.

A064091.author: _Wolfdieter Lang_, Sep 13 2001

A080243.author: _Paul Barry_, Feb 13 2003
gfs: 1 - x/(Q(0) + x) where Q(k) = 1 + k*(1+x) + x + x*(k+1)*(k+2)/Q(k+1); (continued fraction). - _Sergei N. Gladkovskii_, Mar 14 2013
A(x) satisfies: A(x) = (1 - 2*x*A(x)^2) / (1 - x). - _Ilya Gutkovskiy_, Jun 30 2020

A097331.author: _Paul Barry_, Aug 05 2004
gfs: 1/(1-z/(1-z/(1-z/(...)))) where z=x/(1+2*x) (continued fraction); more generally g.f. C(x/(1+2*x)) where C(x) is the g.f. for the Catalan numbers (A000108). - _Joerg Arndt_, Mar 18 2011

A105864.author: _Paul Barry_, Apr 23 2005
gfs: satisfies: A(x) = 1/(1-x^2) + x*A(x)^2. - _Paul D. Hanna_, Sep 06 2011
1/G(x), where G(x) = 1 - x^2 - (x - x^3)/ G(x) (continued fraction). - _Nikolaos Pantelidis_, Jan 08 2023
A105864.name: Expansion of (1/(1-x^2))*c(x/(1-x^2)), where c(x) is the g.f. of A000108.

A109263.author: _Paul Barry_, Jun 24 2005
gfs: x^2c(x)^2/(1-xc(x)-x^2c(x)^2) where c(x) is the g.f. of A000108; a(n)=sum{k=0..n, (k/(2n-k))binomial(2n-k, n-k)(F(k-1)-0^k)}.

A110199.author: _Paul Barry_, Jul 15 2005
gfs: 1/x^2 - G(0)/(1-x)/x^2, where G(k)= 1 - x/(1 - x/(1 + x/(1 + x/G(k+1) ))); (continued fraction). - _Sergei N. Gladkovskii_, Jul 17 2013

A114190.author: _Paul Barry_, Nov 16 2005
A114190.name: Expansion of 1/(1+x*(1-x)*c(-2*x)), c(x) the g.f. of A000108.

A114464.author: _Emeric Deutsch_, Nov 29 2005

A141353.author: _Paul Barry_, Jun 27 2008

A171416.author: _Paul Barry_, Dec 08 2009
A171416.name: A sequence with Somos-4 Hankel transform.

A174808.author: _Paul Barry_, Mar 29 2010

gfs: satisfies A(x) = 1/(1-x-x^2) + x*A(x)^2. - _Paul D. Hanna_, Sep 06 2011
A184018.name: Expansion of c(x/(1-x-x^2)) / (1-x-x^2), c(x) the g.f. of A000108.

A188314.author: _Paul Barry_, Mar 28 2011
gfs: A(x) satisfies: A(x) = 1 + x * (1 + x*A(x) + A(x)^2). - _Ilya Gutkovskiy_, Jul 01 2020
A188314.name: Expansion of (1/(1-x))*c(x/((1-x)*(1-x^2))) where c(x) is the g.f. of A000108.
